source: Environmental Audit Report (2024), pp. 7-10, 41-44; Green Audit Report (2023), pp. 41-45

water_supply.fresh_sources: TWAD Cauvery Combined Water Supply Scheme (5.0 lakh LPD consent) + 27 Campus Borewells & Open Wells (10.2 lakh LPD WRD NOC)
water_supply.recycled_water_use: Toilet flushing (2,118 KLD) and campus landscape/gardening (2,423 KLD) via dual piping

sewage_treatment.monitoring: Online Continuous Effluent Monitoring System (OCEMS) connected to TNPCB server
sewage_treatment.zero_discharge_commitment: 100% campus treated effluent reused internally; zero surface water discharge outside boundary

rainwater_harvesting.collection_structures: UPVC/RCC hume pipes connecting rooftop drainage to 35 recharge bore pits + diversion of runoff into PWD VIT Lake
rainwater_harvesting.lake_role: Central campus stormwater pond acts as permanent percolation tank and aesthetic microclimate moderator

waste_management.biodegradable_disposal: Cattle feed for surrounding rural villages, vermicomposting yard, and 300 m3 biomethanation plant powering 50 kVA and 40 kVA gas engines
waste_management.non_biodegradable_disposal: Source segregation (colour-coded bins on all floors) and recycling via authorized TNPCB vendors
